To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the RCP mechanism based on the peakvalley time-of-use pricing is beneficial for the existing development of the scale of electric vehicles, and the government subsidy is an important driving factor for the development of electric vehicles in the initial period and should be phased out in order to reduce the financial burdens accompanying the amplification in the scale of electric vehicle.

a real-time charge price mechanism for electric vehicles is propitious for their development in the early stage, while it is not necessary to use a dynamic pricing mechanism to promote the development of electric vehicles in a large city.

RCP based the peak-valley TOU is the best option in Beijing, the government subsidies should be phased out, the charging stations should be encouraged to expand, and the EVs should be encouraged to be used as a secondary power source in the future.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of EVs in the context of a power system.
a RCP mechanism of EVs in the context of system dynamics.
the development of EVs and the RCP mechanism in China.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the RCP mechanism is beneficial to the development of EVs and the charging service operators.
a RCP model is a feasible way to manage the development of EVs in China.
RCP based the peak-valley TOU is a better choice to promote the development of EVs in the initial period.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RCP model is a powerful tool to evaluate and optimize the charging service system of EVs.

the RCP mechanism can help the charging service operators to make profits in the long term, and the government should consider the charging power and the scale of EV when designing the charge pricing policy.
RCP is beneficial to EVs and power grid in the long-term.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RCP is beneficial to EVs' development and can help to improve the power grid's efficiency.
the system dynamics model can help to develop a RCP mechanism to promote the development of EVs and charging stations.

RCP based the peak-valley tariff is the most beneficial to all the stakeholders, especially to EV users and charging service operators, while the RCP based on real-time pricing is the most beneficial for the power generation company.
